name: Issue 11181: Homebound Runestone stays put and lets its Runemaster set their Hearthstone there
contract: Homebound Runestone (560316) summons the Primordial Portal (50058) and says it allows the caster to set their Hearthstone at its destination; its aura 803022 reads 'The Runemaster can set their Hearthstone here'. The portal must stay where it was created when its owner walks away, although SummonProperties 61 makes it a guardian, and confirming 'Make this inn your home' at it (CMSG_BINDER_ACTIVATE) must bind the Runemaster there.

steps.label: The Runestone summons the Primordial Portal
